summary: Scheme catalog replaced by the 2026 source (schemes_json_only: 274 central, 53 Tamil Nadu, 79 Maharashtra). Old scheme ids were re-keyed through tools/import_schemes_json.py (see backend/catalog/source/scheme_id_map.json); facets absent from the 2026 files were filled from the previous catalog by tools/build_scheme_supplement.py. Derived catalogs (applicability matrix, search index, cross references) were regenerated and links from authority/institution/finance/tax/export records were remapped to the new scheme ids. Release 1.37.0-alpha also consolidates the runtime catalog into one file: the Hindi and Tamil packs, release identity and scheme id map are embedded in the bundle (bundleFormat 2).
